# Orthogonal-Frequency-Regularized Discriminative Regression for Real-World SR
**RealSR (V3) · ×2 · official Test.m protocol**

**PSNR-Y 34.41 · SSIM 0.9285 · MUSIQ 55.96 · MANIQA 0.3534**

*(binary deck: `docs/slides.pptx`, generated by `docs/make_slides.py`)*

---

## Problem & the honest protocol
- RealSR = real camera zoom pairs (Canon 5D3 / Nikon D810); 390 train / 100 test.
- Numbers are **not** comparable across papers:
  - Limited-range **Y** vs full-range RGB (Y ≈ 0.4–0.8 dB lower)
  - border **shave**, test-subset choice, **Protocol A** (trained on RealSR) vs **B/D** (pretrained blind)
- We report the **strictest** form: Limited-range Y, uint8, modcrop4, **no shave**, all 100 pairs.
- Every external number carries a **protocol tag**.

---

## Method
- **Stride-1** U-Net regressor + residual-bicubic, zero-init head → step-0 = bicubic exactly.
- **Wavelet high-frequency loss**: multi-scale L1 on orthogonal Haar HL/LH/HH (λ≈8).
- **Shift-ensemble** variant (dyadic offsets) ≈ shift-invariance — best perceptual arm.
- **Muon** optimizer (Newton–Schulz orthogonalised updates; AdamW on 1-D), lr 5e-3.
- BSRGAN pretrain → RealSR finetune; D4 8-fold **TTA** at inference.

---

## Baselines: reproduced vs cited
- **Reproduced (same A-strict protocol)**: SwinIR (light/largeish), EDSR-baseline; RCAN / SRResNet / RRDB in pipeline.
- **Cited with protocol tags (never mixed into claims)**: BSRGAN/Real-ESRGAN (D-blind);
  StableSR/DiffBIR/SeeSR/ResShift/SinSR/OSEDiff/AdcSR/TSD-SR/TinySR/PURE/RealSR-R1 (B/C protocols).
- Their RealSR PSNR: **22.6–26.3 dB** on a *synthetically re-degraded* input — a different task.

## The empirical ceiling (training-free, no model)
| wall | ×2 | ×3 | ×4 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Registration E_align (0.3 px) | 37.7 | 37.7 | 37.7 |
| Band-limit E_null (LP→LR Nyquist) | 40.65 | 34.55 | 31.27 |
| Sensor noise E_noise (MAD σ≈0.9/255) | 49.05 | 49.05 | 49.05 |
| **composite (bandlimit+noise)** | **40.1** | 34.4 | 31.2 |
| + 0.3 px residual registration | **35.7** | ~32 | ~29.5 |

×2 is **registration-limited**; our **34.41** sits inside 34.4–35.7.
Corrects the folklore “38–40 dB noise floor” — noise is small, registration is the wall.

---

## Perception–distortion tradeoff, reproduced in-house
- Same protocol: regression **34.41 / 0.9285** vs generative **28.36 / 0.790**.
- Generative trades ~6 dB fidelity for higher no-reference IQA (Blau & Michaeli, CVPR 2018).
- RealSR: fidelity capped by physics, realism capped by the 390-pair data budget.
- → PSNR has no sustainable headroom at ×2; **the future is perceptual**.

---

## Negative results (all evaluated, all reported)
- Mamba/VSS: −2.3 dB at equal sample budget.
- Dual-branch wavelet U-Net, DTCWT, D4 equivariance, coord injection, freq-routing, gated FFN.
- Frequency-domain rectified flow (HF residual generation): monotone destruction → negative.
- Adversarial degradation mining (N3, with Muon): neutral.

---

## Conclusions
- Recipe wins: stride-1 + wavelet-HF(+shift) + Muon + pretrain + TTA → **34.41 / 0.9285 SSIM**.
- ×2 PSNR is physics-capped (~34.4–35.7) — the wall is registration, not noise.
- ×3/×4 remain improvable (lighter-tuned); beyond that, go perceptual.
- Full chronicle: `exp/FINAL_REPORT.md` · baselines: `docs/baseline/` · ceiling tool: `diffusion/oracle.py`
